list.title: Agents
list.subtitle: Executors and coordinators registered for task assignment, with their sub-agents, skills, cost rates, and capacities.
list.syncTooltip: Sync agents, sub-agents and skills from Hermes Foundation
list.emptyDescription: Sync the Hermes Foundation roster above to register agents.
list.confirmDeleteSubAgentDescription: Removes this sub-agent's registration. This action cannot be undone.
list.confirmDeleteAgentDescription: Removes the agent, its sub-agents and skill grants. This action cannot be undone.
list.syncTooltipDetailed: Re-read agents, sub-agents, skills and skill grants from the canonical Hermes Foundation contracts in {{path}}
list.agentToolsTooltip: Registry of tools each agent owns

detail.apiKeyDescription: Individual credential used only when this agent runs Claude, Codex, or Agy. The saved value is encrypted and never displayed again.
detail.subAgentsSubtitle: Subordinate agents with scoped permissions and skills, inherited from this agent.
detail.skillsSubtitle: Versioned, governed capabilities associated with this agent, with risk level and permission boundaries.
detail.noSkills: No skills associated with this agent yet.

profileFiles.title: Profile files
profileFiles.description: The Markdown files that define this agent, read from
profileFiles.noFiles: No profile file is expected for this agent.
profileFiles.homeUnreachableBody: The backend cannot read {{path}}. Register the correct path above, or check the container bind mounts.

roles.soul: Mission, principles and role in the ecosystem — what this agent is.
roles.identity: Name, layer, role, short mission and the reference to the canonical contract.
roles.user: Marcelo's preferences and collaboration context (usually identical across agents).
roles.tools: The specific toolsets this agent needs, plus infrastructure endpoints and boundaries.
roles.agents: Bootstrap entrypoint the runtime loads at session start (usually identical across agents).
roles.claude: Claude Code's native always-loaded entrypoint — the equivalent of AGENTS.md for this runtime.
roles.foundationLink: Standard canonical links back to the Foundation.
roles.heartbeat: Health contract and post-update verification checks, tailored to this agent's role.
roles.memory: This agent's specific memory architecture: sources, precedence, retention and recovery.
roles.continuity: Generated automatically on first run — session continuity state.
roles.subagents: Sub-agent roster. Only for agents that orchestrate sub-agents.

profileFiles.emptyFile: This file is empty. Switch to Edit to write it.

homePath.title: Profile directory
homePath.description: Host directory holding this agent's profile Markdown files (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, TOOLS.md, …).
homePath.hint: Absolute host path. Leave empty to fall back to the runtime default (/root/.hermes/profiles/<slug> for Hermes profiles, /root/.claude, /root/.codex, /root/.gemini/config, /root/.openclaw/workspace for the external runtimes).

hierarchy.title: Agent ecosystem hierarchy
hierarchy.description: Hermes system agents (orchestration, departments, specialists, scoped workers) and the external CLI runtimes, each with its function, skills and profile directory.
hierarchy.baselineWarning: The registered ecosystem is below the current governed baseline: 1 Athos orchestrator + 7 main development agents. Future departments may expand this baseline.
hierarchy.hermesSectionSubtitle: In-house profiles under /root/.hermes/profiles, organised by layer, tier and department.
hierarchy.externalSectionSubtitle: Agents running on their own binary and their own config home, outside the Hermes profile tree.
hierarchy.focusedHint: Showing one agent of {{total}}. Clear the filter to see the whole ecosystem.
hierarchy.retiredSectionSubtitle: Kept for audit and never part of the live org chart. The Foundation sync never deactivates a row on its own — a human retired these.

profileChips.notCreatedHint: {{filename}} does not exist yet in this profile directory.

automation.title: Crons & scripts
automation.description: The scheduled work this agent performs: its hermes cron jobs and the scripts in its own profile directory.
automation.noProfile: This agent has no Hermes profile, so it owns no cron jobs or profile scripts.
automation.storeErrorTitle: This profile's cron store failed to parse — its scheduler has stopped running these jobs.
automation.noCrons: No cron job is scheduled for this profile.
automation.noScripts: This profile's scripts/ directory is empty.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: The MCP servers this agent's runtime loads. ForgeHub edits the runtime's own config file, so a change here is what the agent really gets on its next run.
mcp.empty: No MCP server configured for this agent yet.
mcp.projectNoWorkingDir: This project has no working_directory_path set — set one before configuring MCP servers.
mcp.emptyProject: No MCP server configured for this project yet.
mcp.noToggleHint: This runtime has no enable/disable flag — removing the server is the only way to turn it off.
mcp.parseErrorTitle: This runtime's config file could not be parsed
mcp.removeDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed from {{path}}. The agent loses these tools on its next run.

catalog.empty: No MCP server registered in the catalog yet.
catalog.globalNotice: This server is applied to every eligible agent automatically, including ones registered later — unassigning below only removes it from that one agent, it does not turn the flag off.
catalog.noAssignments: Not assigned to any agent or project yet.
catalog.removeDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed from the catalog. It is NOT removed from any agent/project it was already installed on — unassign it from each one first if you also want it uninstalled there.

form.applyToAllHint: Installs this server on every agent whose runtime supports MCP, including ones registered later — writes to their real config files.

form.name: Name
form.envHint: Values are written to the runtime's config file in plain text — do not put a secret here that the file's readers should not have.

page.byAgentDescription: Expand an agent to add, edit or remove its servers.
page.unsupportedHelp: This agent has no runtime_type, so no runtime would ever load an MCP server for it. Set a runtime on the agent page first.
